lot.name: Lot
lot.title: Lot (Lut)
lot.dict: He believed Abraham and left with him (29:26), and was sent to a people who "lust after men rather than women" (7:81). Angels come to him as guests, his people rush at them, and the town is overturned under a rain of stones; his wife stays behind and perishes (11:77-83, 15:57-77). The Quran counts him among the messengers, without the Bible's story of his daughters.

luqman.name: Luqman
luqman.title: Luqman
luqman.dict: A man given wisdom, whose advice to his son is recorded in the surah named for him (31:12-19). He is not called a prophet, and is not known from the Bible.
